info.title: Al-Sahel Cafe Supplies API
info.description: REST API documentation split by platform: Admin Dashboard, Cafe Mobile App, and Public Storefront.

post.summary: Log in and receive an access token
post.description: Cafe users must login with phone_number and password. The response is a bare bearer token with no permissions. Admin and delegate users may use email instead of phone_number and will receive permissions in the response.

post.summary: Register a cafe account (OTP verification required before login)
post.description: Creates an inactive cafe user and sends a 6-digit OTP. Verify it via POST /cafe/verify-otp: when cafe_auto_approve is active a bearer token is returned immediately, otherwise the account waits for admin approval and only a message is returned.
When cafe_auto_approve is active the user is activated and a bearer token is returned immediately. Otherwise the account stays inactive until an admin approves it, and only a message is returned.

post.summary: Place an order directly (without the cart)

put.summary: Confirm receipt of a delivered order

post.summary: Ask the admins to cancel a pending order

200.description: Addresses and the delivery price at the customer's registered location

delete.description: Soft delete; past orders keep their own copy of the delivery address.

200.description: User fields merged with the customer profile, plus addresses

get.summary: Active delivery zones for the map
Curated product sections chosen by the business (title + products in one object)

200.description: Active sections in display order; each has id, title and products (same card shape as /cafe/products). Sections without available products are omitted.

get.summary: Stock availability for the cart items

post.summary: Add an item to the shopping cart (sets its quantity)
Turn the shopping cart into an order

payment_method.description: wallet = pay the full total from the wallet now

get.summary: Live location of the order's delegate

post.summary: Request a bank-transfer top-up with its receipt; an admin approves it

receipt.description: Transfer receipt: jpg/png/webp/heic or pdf, max 5MB

post.summary: Start an online top-up; open checkout_url to pay

201.description: topup + checkout_url; the wallet is credited when the gateway confirms

get.summary: My favorite products (newest first, product card shape)

200.description: data: products with id, name, image_url, min_price, category_id, default_variant_id, is_favorite, favorited_at

get.summary: Ids of my favorite products (to mark hearts in lists)

post.summary: Request password reset OTP for cafe user
Reset cafe user password with OTP

200.description: Carts with items and current subtotal

post.summary: Place an order from a recurring cart
post.description: The cart is kept as-is so it can be ordered again; prices are the current ones.

post.summary: Payment gateway callback (signed); credits the wallet on success

get.summary: Feature flags for the app UI

user_id.description: Required for admin requests; customers always create addresses for themselves.

image.description: Stored as the product's primary image

ProductVariantRequest.description: A sellable size of a product. Stock lives in inventories; expiry dates on purchase order items.

InventoryRequest.description: POST receives goods (adds to stock, purchase movement); PUT sets the counted on-hand quantity (adjustment movement).

AuthLoginRequest.description: Cafe users must login with phone_number and password only. Email is allowed for admin and delegate users only.

email.description: Use for admin/delegate login only. Cafe users must NOT use email.

AuthResponse.description: For cafe users the response contains only the bearer token. Admin and delegate responses also include permissions.

token.description: Bearer token to use in the Authorization header

permissions.description: Included for admin/delegate users only. Omitted for cafe users.

OrderItemRequest.description: Unit price is always taken from the variant on the server.

OrderRequest.description: Totals, delivery fee and the delivery address snapshot are computed on the server.

user_id.description: The customer the order is for
